checks.message: Provisional status, medium confidence and non-official use limit are explicit.
All three required key areas remain unchanged provisional constraints with warnings.
Concept land-use partition is clipped to and covers the provisional site without overlap.
All editable layers are labelled conceptual non-statutory; existing-condition claims are avoided.
Adaptive-signal proposal is shadow simulation then bounded pilot with human authority, not deployment.
No default facial recognition; aggregate data and non-AI equivalent service are design requirements.
Zero affected-user consultation is disclosed; personas are synthetic and cannot prove acceptance.
Offline static HTML uses local assets and no remote requests, forms or tracking.
Sources, standards, depth items, geometry, metrics, assumptions and review limits are cross-referenced.
